lines.en: label day154:
scene tsuneyomoves1
It’s day-two of helping my new students move into their dorms and, today, I’m accompanied by none other than Miku and Futaba.
lines.zh: 帮新学生搬进宿舍的第二天，今天陪我来的不是别人，正是 Miku 和 Futaba。

lines.en: And when I say “I’m accompanied,” it’s really closer to me accompanying them.
lines.zh: 不过说是「陪我」，倒更像是我陪着她们。

lines.en: Tsuneyo didn’t actually invite me to help, I just heard about it in class and decided to show up unannounced.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 其实并没请我来帮忙，我只是在课上听说了这事，就决定不打招呼直接过来。

lines.en: But hey, virtually every visit I’ve had to the dorms has been unannounced so far. Might as well not do anything to break the streak.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我到现在为止去宿舍几乎次次都是不请自来。干脆别打破这个纪录算了。

lines.en: : Hey. What are you two up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你俩在忙什么呢？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves2
: Oh, hey Sensei! I didn’t know you were comin’ today!
lines.zh: : 哦，哟，Sensei！我不知道你今天会来！

lines.en: : Neither did I, to be honest. Just sort of happened.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我自己也不知道。就是这么巧。

lines.en: : Are you here to help Tsuneyo move as well?
lines.zh: : 您也是来帮 Tsuneyo 搬家的吗？

lines.en: : You know it. Anything I can do to help.
lines.zh: : 那当然。能帮上忙的我都做。

lines.en: : Does sitting around drinking water really constitute helping, though? It doesn’t seem like you’re doing much.
lines.zh: : 不过坐着喝水真算得上是帮忙吗？看你们也没干多少活。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves3
: Hey! Watch it! We did plenty of stuff before you got here!
lines.zh: : 喂！说话给我注意点！你来之前我们可干了不少活！

lines.en: : God forbid we take a second to drink some water. Jeez, kids these days!
lines.zh: : 我们喝口水的功夫都不行吗？天哪，现在的年轻人真是的！

lines.en: : Please forgive her tone, Sensei...Miku’s actually worked really hard today.
lines.zh: : 请别介意她的语气，Sensei……Miku 今天其实真的很卖力。

lines.en: : That’s heckin’ right, I have. And so has Futaba! We’ve carried like a bajillion different boxes and like, 90%% of ‘em have been clothes!
lines.zh: : 他妈的说得太对了，我确实很卖力。Futaba 也是！我们搬了得有一亿个箱子，而且其中大概 90%% 都是衣服！

lines.en: : I’ve...done my best. I can’t exactly carry as much as Miku.
lines.zh: : 我……已经尽力了。我毕竟搬不了 Miku 那么多。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves4
: Yeah, but that’s probs just cause those big ole’ honkers keep gettin’ in the way.
lines.zh: : 是啦，不过大概是因为那对大灯笼老是挡道吧。

lines.en: : That’s not...entirely incorrect. I wish you’d be a little less abrasive, though.
lines.zh: : 这话说得……也不算全错。不过我希望你能稍微委婉一点。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves5
: Sensei! Translation request! The heck does ‘abrasive’ mean?
lines.zh: : Sensei！翻译请求！「委婉」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : It means Futaba wants you to be a little less candid when you talk about her chest.
lines.zh: : 意思是 Futaba 希望你聊起她的胸部时，别那么口无遮拦。

lines.en: : Oooooh. I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦。懂了，懂了。

lines.en: : The heck does ‘candid’ mean?
lines.zh: : 那「口无遮拦」又是什么意思？

lines.en: : It means that you shouldn’t make fun of Futaba’s boobs.
lines.zh: : 意思是你别拿 Futaba 的胸部开玩笑。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves6
: I ain’t makin’ fun of em! I’d kill for those puppies! I’m not even wearin’ a friggin bra right now.
lines.zh: : 我哪有拿它们开玩笑！那对宝贝我羡慕都羡慕不来！我现在连个该死的胸罩都没穿。

lines.en: : And I’d kill to be able to do that...
lines.zh: : 我也羡慕得要死……

lines.en: Ahh, I’ve reached the point of my life where my students are no longer concerned with talking about their chests in front of me.
lines.zh: 啊，我的人生已经到了这一步：我的学生们当着我的面聊起胸部来，已经毫无顾忌了。

lines.en: Hard work really does pay off.
lines.zh: 努力真的会有回报。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves7
: Sorry, you two. But as much as I’d like to stay and talk about boobs with you, would you mind telling me where Tsuneyo is?
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，二位。虽然我也很想留下来跟你们聊胸部，不过能告诉我 Tsuneyo 在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : I feel like I’m obligated to at least try to help her tonight.
lines.zh: : 我觉得今晚怎么也得试着帮帮她。

lines.en: That and I’d also like her to be a part of this conversation as well. I haven’t seen much of Tsuneyo, but I definitely think her body is rather...developed for her age.
lines.zh: 此外，我也挺想让她加入到这个话题里来。虽然我没怎么见过 Tsuneyo，但我觉得就她的年纪而言，身材确实……相当有料。

lines.en: : Hm? You blind, Sensei? She’s right behind ya.
lines.zh: : 嗯？Sensei 你瞎了吗？她不就在你背后。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: I turn around and-
lines.zh: 我转过身去——

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves8
: Hi, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Ah-
: Do you need help with those boxes?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮你搬这些箱子吗？

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : I have to carry much heavier things at the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 在店里我得搬比这重得多的东西。

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m sure you can normally {i}see{/i} when you carry those things.
lines.zh: : 是吗，不过我猜你搬那些东西的时候，通常是能{i}看见路{/i}的。

lines.en: : That is a good point.
lines.zh: : 您说得有道理。

lines.en: : So can I take a box then?
lines.zh: : 那我能拿一个箱子吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves9
Tsuneyo’s expressionless face pops into my vision as I take a box full of her clothes from the top of the stack.
lines.zh: 我从箱子堆的最上面搬起一箱她的衣服，Tsuneyo 那张面无表情的脸便闯进了我的视线。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Come here often?
lines.zh: : 你常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : Are you hitting on me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在撩我吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 应该不是。

lines.en: : Really? Because it sounds a lot like you’re hitting on me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？可这话听起来很像在撩我。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what that means.
lines.zh: : 我连那是什么意思都不知道。

lines.en: : That aside, how are you feeling about the move? Have you gotten used to Molly yet?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，搬家感觉怎么样？你已经习惯 Molly 了吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves10
Tsuneyo looks off to the side instead of answering my question.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 没有回答我的问题，而是把视线移向了一边。

lines.en: I assume this means she-
lines.zh: 我猜这意味着她——

lines.en: : Is that a bird?
lines.zh: : 那是只鸟吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves11
: Is that thing really still there? I figured it would have left by now.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿居然还在？我还以为它早飞走了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves10
: We should give it a name.
lines.zh: : 我们该给它起个名字。

lines.en: : You want to name a bird that’s probably going to fly away in a day or two?
lines.zh: : 你想给一只一两天后大概就会飞走的鸟起名字？

lines.en: : You don’t?
lines.zh: : 您不想吗？

lines.en: : No, I kind of do as well.
lines.zh: : 不，我其实也有点想。

lines.en: : Let’s name him Noodles.
lines.zh: : 就叫它 Noodles 吧。

lines.en: : You need interests besides noodles, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你得在面条之外再培养点别的爱好。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves12
: Fuck you.
lines.zh: : Fuck you。

lines.en: WOAH.
lines.zh: 哇哦。

lines.en: Where the hell did that come from?
lines.zh: 这他妈是哪冒出来的？

lines.en: : Uhh...did I do something to offend you?
lines.zh: : 呃……我是不是哪里得罪你了？

lines.en: : The only thing that offends me is when someone only eats half of their dinner.
lines.zh: : 唯一能让我生气的，就是有人晚饭只吃一半。

lines.en: : You haven’t eaten dinner. You are fine.
lines.zh: : 您还没吃晚饭。所以您没事。

lines.en: : Then why did you curse at me?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么骂我？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves13
: Curse? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 骂？那是什么意思？

lines.en: : You said “Fuck you” just now. The word “fuck” is a curse.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说了「Fuck you」。「fuck」这个词是脏话。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves14
: Oh no. What have I done?
lines.zh: : 糟糕。我都干了什么？

lines.en: Tsuneyo suddenly drops her boxes on the floor in front of her. A loud thud rings out and likely echoes throughout the first dorm floor.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 突然把怀里的箱子摔在她面前的地上。一声巨响传来，大概整层宿舍一楼都听得见。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, your computer was in one of those boxes...
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你的电脑就在其中一个箱子里……

lines.en: : Are you going to die?
lines.zh: : 您会死吗？

lines.en: : What? Why would I die?
lines.zh: : 什么？我为什么会死？

lines.en: : The curse.
lines.zh: : 因为那个诅咒。

lines.en: : ...It’s not that kind of curse.
lines.zh: : ……那不是那种诅咒。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves15
: So...you will live?
lines.zh: : 那么……您会活下去？

lines.en: : I will very much live.
lines.zh: : 我会活得好好的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves16
: I’ve been bestowed with too much power...
lines.zh: : 我被赋予了过于强大的力量……

lines.en: : I have absolutely no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道您在说什么。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves17
: That curse was taught to me by the Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 那个诅咒是翡翠守护者教给我的。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, it’s not that kind of curse.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，那不是那种诅咒。

lines.en: : Even if it is a weak curse, I shouldn’t have placed it on you.
lines.zh: : 就算那只是个微弱的诅咒，我也不该把它加在您身上。

lines.en: : I am sorry. You may eat for free at my family’s shop whenever you like for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉。今后您随时都可以到我家店里免费吃饭，一辈子都行。

lines.en: : No, that’s fine. I’ll still pay.
lines.zh: : 不，不用了。我还是照付。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Yes...
lines.zh: : 真的不用……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves18
: Ah-
: Ay! The heck are you two doin’ over there? And why’d ramen-girl drop her computer on the ground?
lines.zh: : 哎！你俩在那边搞什么鬼？还有拉面妹干嘛把电脑摔在地上？

lines.en: : You gotta be careful with loud noises like that! You never know who might freak out and get scared from ‘em.
lines.zh: : 这种巨响可得小心点！你永远不知道谁会被吓得崩溃。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves19
I turn around to find an uncharacteristically angry looking Miku, though I imagine I know why.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到 Miku 一脸怒气，这可不像她——不过我大概知道为什么。

lines.en: The only time I’ve ever seen her lose her composure was after that ball hit the storage room that one time.
lines.zh: 我唯一一次见她失态，就是那次球砸到储藏室的时候。

lines.en: I guess I should be glad that she didn’t have another reaction like that now.
lines.zh: 我想我该庆幸她这次没有再出现那种反应。

lines.en: I was lucky enough that Karin was around last time. I have no idea how I’d be able to handle something like that alone.
lines.zh: 上次多亏 Karin 在旁边。我完全不知道要是我一个人该怎么应付那种场面。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves20
: I’m very sorry for the disturbance. I had no idea a computer could make that kind of noise.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉造成了骚动。我不知道电脑能发出那种声音。

lines.en: It’s not like it’s {i}supposed{/i} to...
lines.zh: 它本来也{i}不该{/i}发出那种声音……

lines.en: : I’m not mad at you. I’m mad at {i}him{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我没生你的气。我生{i}他{/i}的气。

lines.en: : Wait, me? What did I do?
lines.zh: : 等等，我？我干什么了？

lines.en: : I don’t know her enough to get mad at her yet. I gotta take it out on somebody.
lines.zh: : 我跟她还不够熟，生不了她的气。总得找个人发泄一下吧。

lines.en: : Drop and give me twenty, mister.
lines.zh: : 趴下，给我做二十个，老兄。

lines.en: : I am absolutely not going to do that.
lines.zh: : 我绝对不会做那种事。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves21
: Fine! Futaba! Drop and give me twenty!
lines.zh: : 行！Futaba！趴下，给我做二十个！

lines.en: : What?! Twenty sounds like a lot...I don’t even know if I could do that many...
lines.zh: : 什么？！二十个听起来好多……我都不确定自己做不做得到……

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves22
: I will accept this punishment...It is the least I can do.
lines.zh: : 我接受这个惩罚……这至少是我能做的。

lines.en: : Hm? Hey, wait a sec Tsuneyo. You don’t have to-
lines.zh: : 嗯？哎，等等，Tsuneyo。你不用——

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves23
: And now she’s doing it.
lines.zh: : 她还真做起来了。

lines.en: Tsuneyo quickly drops to the floor and begins to do push-ups.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 迅速趴到地上，开始做俯卧撑。

lines.en: She’s surprisingly quick too...
lines.zh: 而且她速度还出奇地快……

lines.en: I wonder if she works out often?
lines.zh: 我怀疑她是不是经常锻炼？

lines.en: : You need to watch what you say around her, Miku. I don’t think Tsuneyo is...all there just yet.
lines.zh: : Miku，你在她面前说话得注意点。我觉得 Tsuneyo 还……不太灵光。

lines.en: : She’s...really good at those...
lines.zh: : 她……做得真好……

lines.en: : Well how the heck was I supposed to know? No one’s ever actually listened to me when I’ve said that before! Not even the girls on the team!
lines.zh: : 我他妈怎么会知道？以前我说这话，根本没人真的照做过！连队里的女生都不听！

lines.en: : From what she’s told me, she’s been pretty sheltered most of her life, so I’d imagine there are some other cues she’d miss out on as well.
lines.zh: : 据她所说，她这辈子大多过得挺封闭的，所以我想其他的一些暗示她大概也领会不到。

lines.en: : ...Twenty.
scene tsuneyomoves24
: The curse has been lifted.
lines.zh: : 诅咒已经解除了。

lines.en: : Curse?...
: The curse I placed on Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我施加在 Sensei 身上的诅咒。

lines.en: : Molly taught her the F word.
lines.zh: : Molly 教了她那个 F 开头的词。

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves25
: The F word? You mean...fuck?
lines.zh: : F 开头的词？您是说……fuck？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves26
: Dear God...not again...
lines.zh: : 天哪……又来了……

lines.en: : What have I done?
lines.zh: : 我都干了什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyomoves27
Tsuneyo drops to the floor and, once again, attempts to break the curse...
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 又一次趴到地上，试图破解这个诅咒……

lines.en: : One...two...three-
: Jeez. You weren’t wrong about that whole pickin’ up on cues thing.
lines.zh: : 天哪。你说她领会不到暗示，还真没错。

lines.en: : This one...is definitely my fault...
lines.zh: : 这次……绝对是我的错……

lines.en: scene black
Today’s move-in operation ended on a significantly less successful note than the last one.
lines.zh: 今天的搬家行动，收场比上一次要狼狈得多。

lines.en: But even with that being said, it seemed like Tsuneyo and the others were able to get most of the work done before I even showed up.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，看起来 Tsuneyo 她们在我出现之前就已经把大部分活干完了。

lines.en: And while I’m not exactly sure what became of the computer she dropped on the ground, I do know that pretty much everything else she owned made it into her room undamaged.
lines.zh: 虽然我不太确定她摔在地上的那台电脑后来怎么样了，但我知道她其余的东西基本都完好无损地进了房间。

lines.en: It’s a shame I haven’t gotten to see the inside of the dorm yet, but I imagine I’ll be able to soon enough...
lines.zh: 有点可惜我还没能看看宿舍里面长什么样，不过我想很快就会有机会……

lines.en: I just need to spend a little more time with her and Molly.
lines.zh: 我只需要再多花点时间陪陪她和 Molly。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! Molly and Tsuneyo are officially part of the class!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！Molly 和 Tsuneyo 正式成为班上的一员！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Both of them can now be visited at night at either of their workplaces or their dorm room!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在晚上可以去她们工作的地方或是宿舍房间找她们两个了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Spend enough time with them and eventually they’ll be cool with performing sex acts on you!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只要陪她们的时间够久，早晚她们都会愿意为你做那种事的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Praise be!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}赞美主！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]!{/i}
